_doc: A9: recorded answers of the AI page-role call (ClassifyPatternPages) for the corpus PDFs the call is made for (a page set aside that holds line work). Filled BY EYE from the rendered pages on 11.10 (no paid call): role, confidence, evidence. Only pages that were looked at are recorded (polupalto: the 41 pages the call sends). Keys are 1-based page numbers or ranges a-b. Read by scripts/pattern-import/page-roles-fixture.ts (the probes' PageRoleDeps).
